name: capell-app/welcome-tour
description: Admin dashboard checklist of four setup jobs for new editors, ticked by the work itself or by hand, with a place to write optional tour steps.

healthChecks.label: Welcome Tour panel registration, dashboard, settings, and user state storage are healthy.

marketplace.summary: A Getting started checklist across the top of the admin dashboard that gives each new editor four jobs and a link to each.
marketplace.description: Give new editors a first screen to work from. A Getting started checklist sits across the top of the admin dashboard and covers your site and domain, a first page, a theme and a package to extend the site. Jobs tick as the work happens or by hand, and a job a person has no permission to open does not appear for them. Owners can write tour steps in the Welcome tour settings, though none come ready-made.
marketplace.problem: I gave my editor a login and they emailed asking where to start.
marketplace.outcome: The dashboard shows each editor which of the four setup jobs are ticked and which are still open.

faq.question: Who sees the Getting started checklist?
faq.answer: Editors and every kind of admin. Visitors never see it, and jobs a person has no permission to open are left out of their list.

faq.question: Is the checklist the same for everyone?
faq.answer: No. Each person has their own checklist state, so ticking a job or hiding the checklist affects only that person.

faq.question: Can I hide it once I know my way around?
faq.answer: Yes. Anyone can hide it from their own dashboard without changing what other people see.

faq.question: Do I have to write tour steps?
faq.answer: No. The checklist works with none, and owners can add notes for each screen in the Welcome tour settings.

faq.question: Which jobs tick themselves?
faq.answer: Saving the site, a page appearing, a theme other than the default being switched on and a package being enabled after install. Anyone can also tick a job by hand.
